category_scope: Beauty & Personal Care (hair care, skin care, oral care); general rules where noted

languages.note: English mandatory; Arabic optional (noon advises at least an Arabic title). noon does not translate free-text content.
English mandatory; Arabic optional (noon advises at least an Arabic title). noon does not translate free-text content.

rules.requirement: The title should be between 5 and 200 characters long (upper bound).
rules.source_title: Title requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU
rules.notes: Conflict inside the same article: the 'Title too long' example states 'The title must not exceed 160 characters' - see title.max_length.qc_example. Violations are listed by noon as reasons for rejection by its quality check (QC) team.

rules.requirement: The article's 'Title too long' rejection example states that the title must not exceed 160 characters.
rules.source_title: Title requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU
rules.notes: Use 160 as the safe target and 200 as the hard ceiling until noon reconciles the two numbers.

rules.requirement: The title should be between 5 and 200 characters long (lower bound).
rules.source_title: Title requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU
rules.notes: Conflict inside the same article: the 'Title too short' example states 'The title should not be less than 20 characters' - see title.min_length.qc_example.

rules.requirement: The article's 'Title too short' rejection example states that the title should not be less than 20 characters.
rules.source_title: Title requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: The title must contain the product type or sub-type and the product's top features while staying as short as possible.
rules.source_title: Title requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU
rules.notes: 'Product Type Missing' and 'Missing Product Features' are documented title issues. Violations are listed by noon as reasons for rejection by its quality check (QC) team.

rules.requirement: Titles must not include special characters (examples: @ ^ * # &).
rules.source_title: Title requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU
rules.notes: Violations are listed by noon as reasons for rejection by its quality check (QC) team.

rules.requirement: Do not use ALL CAPS; capitalize only the first letter of each word except prepositions, conjunctions and articles. Acronyms (UAE, HP, LED) may be upper case and product series must be written as the brand writes them.
rules.source_title: Title requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU
rules.notes: Rejection reason 'Title - Formatting/Spelling/Grammatical Error'.

rules.requirement: Titles must not include promotional phrases, prices, shipping options or irrelevant search keywords.
rules.source_title: Title requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: Titles must not contain prohibited, banned or restricted words.
rules.source_title: Title requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU
rules.notes: noon maintains a Prohibited Keywords List as a Google Sheet linked from 'Guidelines for prohibited items and keywords'; the sheet itself was not retrieved.

rules.requirement: Titles must not contain repetitive words. Do not repeat attributes that noon concatenates into the displayed title automatically (for example the colour name is appended as a suffix in apparel).
rules.source_title: Title requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU
rules.notes: Rejection reason 'Title - Word Repetition'. Which attributes are concatenated depends on the product type and is not listed publicly.

rules.requirement: Titles must be free of spelling errors and grammatically correct.
rules.source_title: Title requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: Product information in the title must be identical to the specifications, feature bullets and long description, and images must depict the product described in the title (for example the same pack quantity).
rules.source_title: Title requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU
rules.notes: Rejection reasons 'Title - Mismatches with the Attributes/Description' and 'Title - Mismatch with Image/Content'.

rules.requirement: The article lists the brand name among items a title should not include.
rules.source_title: Title requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU
rules.notes: Recorded as recommended, not mandatory: the brand is a separate core attribute, but 'brand in title' is not among the documented rejection reasons and the article's own examples contain brand-like words.

rules.requirement: Keep titles concise, well written, easy to read and unique; mention only important features and move extra information to the feature bullets (avoid keyword stuffing).
rules.source_title: Title requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: Write 5 feature bullets (product highlights) per product, focused on the key selling points.
rules.source_title: Feature bullets (product highlights) and description for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: Feature bullets must not exceed 250 characters per bullet point.
rules.source_title: Feature bullets (product highlights) and description for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: Feature bullets must not include sales or promotional information, special characters (examples: ^ 1/2 @ * # $), references to other marketplaces ('Sold on Amazon', 'Namshi'), emojis, links to a store, contact information or external websites, or HTML tags.
rules.source_title: Feature bullets (product highlights) and description for the seller SKU
rules.notes: Rejection reasons 'Feature Bullets/Description - Hyperlink' and '- HTML Tags'. Violations are listed by noon as reasons for rejection by its quality check (QC) team.

rules.requirement: Feature bullets must match the title and specifications, must not repeat the same information across bullets and must be free of grammatical and spelling errors.
rules.source_title: Feature bullets (product highlights) and description for the seller SKU
rules.notes: Rejection reasons 'Information Mismatch', 'Word Repetition' and 'Incorrect sentence formation'.

rules.requirement: Capitalize the first letter of each bullet, do not end a bullet with punctuation, use semicolons to separate phrases, keep bullets brief yet descriptive and put the most important features first.
rules.source_title: Feature bullets (product highlights) and description for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: A good product description must not be less than 250 characters.
rules.source_title: Feature bullets (product highlights) and description for the seller SKU
rules.notes: Stated among the tips for effective descriptions; whether Seller Lab enforces it is not documented. A description of only two or three words is given as a wrong example.

rules.requirement: A product description should not exceed 4000 characters.
rules.source_title: Feature bullets (product highlights) and description for the seller SKU
rules.notes: Stated among the tips; a system limit is not documented.

rules.requirement: Descriptions must not contain price, shipping or warranty information, brand history or seller information, prohibited or restricted content, emojis, links to a store or other websites, HTML tags, ALL CAPS text or bold/italic styling, and must not contradict the title, images, feature bullets or specifications.
rules.source_title: Feature bullets (product highlights) and description for the seller SKU
rules.notes: 'Rejection reasons for description are the same as those above for feature bullets.'

rules.requirement: Descriptions should be unique to the product, useful, clear, grammatically correct and place the most important information first; avoid generic text.
rules.source_title: Feature bullets (product highlights) and description for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: Mandatory attributes are defined per category or sub-category and must be 100% complete before a Seller SKU is submitted to noon's quality check.
rules.source_title: Seller SKU content quality
rules.notes: Mandatory fields are star-marked in Seller Lab. The two help articles disagree on the template colour (green in 'The seller SKU product attributes', red in 'Seller SKU bulk creation'). The Content API states that a product cannot enter QC until completeness reaches 100%.

rules.requirement: Category and brand are core Seller SKU information; if they are chosen incorrectly the SKU is rejected and a new SKU must be created.
rules.source_title: Seller SKU content quality

rules.requirement: For attributes with a drop-down list, select only existing values; enter each value under the correct attribute header; values must not contradict the official brand website.
rules.source_title: The seller SKU product attributes
rules.notes: Rejection reasons 'Attributes - Incorrect Value' (drop-down list, wrong header, brand website mismatch).

rules.requirement: Attribute values must be correctly spelled and capitalized (not ALL CAPS, not all lower case) and must not repeat the same data across attributes (for example model name versus model number).
rules.source_title: The seller SKU product attributes
rules.notes: Rejection reasons 'Attributes - Formatting/Spelling/Grammatical Error' and 'Attributes - Word Repetition'.

rules.requirement: Write the brand name exactly as the manufacturer writes it; for an unbranded or generic product set the brand to 'generic' (not 'N/A', 'No brand' or 'unbranded').
rules.source_title: The seller SKU brand

rules.requirement: Fill in as many optional attributes as possible; noon shows the percentage of optional attributes completed and says it improves the overall quality of the Seller SKU.
rules.source_title: The seller SKU product attributes

rules.requirement: The mandatory attributes for beauty categories (ingredients, scent, hair type, skin type, expiry or shelf life, country of origin, unit count) are not listed on the public help pages retrieved.
rules.source_title: The seller SKU product attributes
rules.notes: They are defined per category in the Seller Lab templates and are returned by the Content API ListCategoryAttributes operation (needs credentials). The only public example of an expiry-type attribute is for food and beverages (shelf life and storage requirements).

rules.requirement: A barcode on every unit is mandatory for products sold through Fulfilled by noon or Fulfilled by Partner; each SKU, including each size or colour version, must have its own unique barcode mapped in Seller Lab.
rules.source_title: Barcode requirements
rules.notes: Products without barcodes are rejected during quality checks and cannot be fulfilled. Mapping a barcode to each SKU is one of noon's go-live conditions.

rules.requirement: If the product has no manufacturer barcode (EAN/UPC), create a custom alphanumeric barcode of up to 16 characters or use the Partner SKU or model number; do not use symbols (+ / - % &) or spaces.
rules.source_title: Barcode requirements

rules.requirement: A GTIN is entered 'if applicable' during SKU creation and is also used as the partner barcode in the bulk template; noon does not state that a GS1-registered GTIN is required to list.
rules.source_title: Single SKU creation
rules.notes: GS1 verification and GTIN-exemption processes are not documented on the public pages retrieved.

rules.requirement: Creating duplicate listings of the same SKU is prohibited; noon may delist the duplicate or the entire partner catalog.
rules.source_title: Product listing policy

rules.requirement: A brand that does not yet exist on noon must be registered and approved before its products can go live; some brands and categories are gated and only whitelisted sellers may sell them.
rules.source_title: Product listing policy
rules.notes: noon-controlled brands are listed as noon SKUs (NSKU), whose content is owned and modified by noon.

rules.requirement: At least one good-quality image is needed for a Seller SKU to go live.
rules.source_title: Seller SKU content quality
rules.notes: Content API: a product needs at least one image that is both REVIEW_STATUS_VALID and VISIBILITY_STATUS_VISIBLE before it can go live.

rules.requirement: The primary image must have a pure white background (for fashion a light grey background is recommended).
rules.source_title: Image requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU
rules.notes: Rejection reason 'Image - Needs Editing' (unclear background, frame, border, price, expiry/manufacturing date, watermark, shadow).

rules.requirement: The primary image must be a front view of the product, must not be a lifestyle image, must not combine multiple views of the product, and may have only light shadows (no hard shadows or reflections).
rules.source_title: Image requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: The product must be displayed outside its packaging in the primary image: no boxes, bags, cases or brand or swing tags.
rules.source_title: Image requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU
rules.notes: Rejection reason 'Image - Need product image without packaging'. Full bundles must be depicted in the primary image when a bundle is sold.

rules.requirement: The primary image must show the entire product; cropped or half images are not allowed.
rules.source_title: Image requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: Images must be submitted in JPEG or JPG format only.
rules.source_title: Image requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: Image width must be at least 660 pixels.
rules.source_title: Image requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: The width-to-height ratio of an image must be at least 0.5.
rules.source_title: Image requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: Image resolution must be at least 72 PPI.
rules.source_title: Image requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: An image must not exceed 10 MB.
rules.source_title: Image requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU
rules.notes: Colour format RGB/sRGB.

rules.requirement: The product must cover at least 70-80% of the image frame.
rules.source_title: Image requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU
rules.notes: Margins: leave about 10% at top and bottom for vertical shots and about 5% at each side for horizontal shots.

rules.requirement: A pixel threshold for image zoom is not documented; noon links clarity when zoomed to the 72 PPI minimum.
rules.source_title: Image requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: Upload a minimum of 3 high-quality images showing different angles, sizes and textures.
rules.source_title: Image requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: The single-SKU creation flow accepts 1 to 9 product images.
rules.source_title: Single SKU creation
rules.notes: Stated for the Seller Lab single-SKU flow; a limit for bulk templates or the API is not documented.

rules.requirement: Images must match the title and description and be high-resolution photographs (no CAD drawings, thumbnails or illustrations). They must not contain logos, watermarks, seller names, unwanted text or objects, borders, price or warranty information, manufacturing or expiry dates, accessories that are not included, placeholder images or duplicates.
rules.source_title: Image requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU
rules.notes: Rejection reasons include 'Low resolution', 'Duplicate Images', 'Conflicting images', 'Needs Editing' and 'Broken Images'. Text added to images must not be offensive or contain banned words.

rules.requirement: Standard image order: front view, back view, side view, other angles, details, usage.
rules.source_title: Image requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU
rules.notes: 'Image - Incorrect sequencing' is a listed rejection reason, but noon accepts the nearest matching angle when the exact one is unavailable.

rules.requirement: Video upload in Seller Lab is enabled only for a limited group of sellers (phased rollout). Sellers without the 'Add video' button can send the file through a Seller Support ticket for the catalog team to upload.
rules.source_title: Video guidelines and rejection reasons for seller SKUs
rules.notes: Turn-around for ticket uploads: typically 1-2 business days once the file passes QC.

rules.requirement: Accepted video formats: MP4, MOV, WEBM (MP4 recommended).
rules.source_title: Video guidelines and rejection reasons for seller SKUs

rules.requirement: Minimum video resolution is 480p; 1080p or higher is recommended.
rules.source_title: Video guidelines and rejection reasons for seller SKUs

rules.requirement: Maximum video file size is 5 GB (optimal: 10 MB).
rules.source_title: Video guidelines and rejection reasons for seller SKUs
rules.notes: Conflict: the 'Additional Media Guidelines' at the end of the feature-bullets article give older PDP video limits - MP4 only, less than 2 minutes, less than 8 MB.

rules.requirement: Maximum video duration is 2.5 minutes (optimal: 30 seconds).
rules.source_title: Video guidelines and rejection reasons for seller SKUs
rules.notes: Older guideline in the feature-bullets article: less than 2 minutes.

rules.requirement: Videos must be in English or Arabic only.
rules.source_title: Video guidelines and rejection reasons for seller SKUs

rules.requirement: Videos must not contain pricing or discounts, shipping information, customer reviews or ratings, guarantees or warranties, competitor comparisons, seller contact details, external links, QR codes or URLs, more than one brand logo on screen, copyrighted material without permission, or offensive, sexual or unsafe content.
rules.source_title: Video guidelines and rejection reasons for seller SKUs
rules.notes: Rejection codes include invalid_video_content, inconsistent_video_content, banned_products_copyright and banned_products_food_drugs_animals.

rules.requirement: A+ content on noon currently supports image banners only; they appear on the product detail page under Product Features, immediately after the specifications, in top-to-bottom order.
rules.source_title: A+ content on noon: Enhancing your product pages
rules.notes: Added in Seller Lab: Catalog > My Catalog > product > Content tab > Additional Media > Add A+ Content.

rules.requirement: Up to 10 image banners can be added per product.
rules.source_title: A+ content on noon: Enhancing your product pages
rules.notes: Conflict: the older 'Banner Guidelines' in the feature-bullets article describe a 'Rich Card' of between 6 and 13 banners.

rules.requirement: A+ banner width must be at least 1800 pixels (recommended 2400, maximum 3600); height is dynamic.
rules.source_title: A+ content on noon: Enhancing your product pages
rules.notes: Each image is validated automatically on upload. Older guideline in the feature-bullets article: 2000 x 1000 pixels, width 2000, maximum height 5102, 150-200 DPI, .jpg.

rules.requirement: A+ banner width must not exceed 3600 pixels.
rules.source_title: A+ content on noon: Enhancing your product pages

rules.requirement: A+ banners must be JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 10 MB per image, clear and not blurry or corrupted.
rules.source_title: A+ content on noon: Enhancing your product pages

rules.requirement: Do not reuse images that are already in the product image carousel as A+ banners.
rules.source_title: A+ content on noon: Enhancing your product pages

rules.requirement: A+ banners can be added separately for English and Arabic.
rules.source_title: A+ content on noon: Enhancing your product pages

rules.requirement: Avoid too much text inside banners, make them mobile-friendly, use high-resolution lifestyle imagery and keep a clear top-to-bottom story.
rules.source_title: A+ content on noon: Enhancing your product pages

rules.requirement: Eligibility criteria for A+ content on noon (for example brand ownership) are not stated on the public page.
rules.source_title: A+ content on noon: Enhancing your product pages
rules.notes: The article describes the feature as available from the product's Content tab in Seller Lab; no brand-registration prerequisite, text modules, comparison charts or prohibited-claims list is published.

rules.requirement: No backend or hidden search-term field is documented for noon listings.
rules.source_title: Title requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU
rules.notes: Public guidance on discoverability is limited to accurate categorization, complete attributes and titles without irrelevant search keywords.

rules.requirement: Do not add irrelevant search keywords to the title or stuff it with features; extra information belongs in the feature bullets.
rules.source_title: Title requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: Sizes are added as child SKUs under a parent SKU; the description is shared across variations while price, stock and (for colours) images can differ per variant.
rules.source_title: Creating product variations: adding sizes, colors, and other attributes
rules.notes: Variations can only be added to Seller SKUs of the seller's own brand.

rules.requirement: Colour and other attribute variations are linked through Groups; the attribute axes are predetermined per category and only parent SKUs of the same brand can be added to the same group.
rules.source_title: Creating product variations: adding sizes, colors, and other attributes

rules.requirement: noon applies a monthly limit of up to 25,000 new products; size variants under one parent count as one product, each colour variant and each unlinked SKU counts individually.
rules.source_title: Product listing policy

rules.requirement: No dedicated bundle or multipack listing policy is published; the only stated rule is that a bundle's primary image must show the full bundle.
rules.source_title: Image requirements and rejection reasons for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: UAE and Saudi Arabia: English content is mandatory for every Seller SKU and must be approved for the product to go live.
rules.source_title: Seller SKU content language requirements

rules.requirement: UAE and Saudi Arabia: Arabic content is optional, but noon advises providing at least the Arabic title; with English-only content the product may be shown only on the English site and hidden from the Arabic one.
rules.source_title: Seller SKU content language requirements
rules.notes: In Egypt (outside this scope) either English or Arabic must be approved.

rules.requirement: noon does not translate Seller SKU content: free-text fields such as title, description and feature bullets must be written by the seller in each language; only standardized drop-down values are translated automatically.
rules.source_title: Listing products on noon - FAQs
rules.notes: The Content Export import lets sellers download content in English and Arabic and add the missing language in bulk.

rules.requirement: The Content Export import in Seller Lab downloads all content of a Partner SKU in English and Arabic so that missing translations can be added and re-uploaded in bulk.
rules.source_title: Seller SKU content export and translation

rules.requirement: Every Seller SKU is reviewed by noon's content quality team; the content must be QC-approved before the product can go live. Statuses: Content Pending, QC Pending, Approved, Rejected, shown separately for English and Arabic.
rules.source_title: Seller SKU content quality
rules.notes: Rejections are 'fatal content rejections' (must be fixed) or 'suggestions for content improvement' (do not block approval).

rules.requirement: noon aims to approve or reject Seller SKU content within 2 business days of submission.
rules.source_title: Seller SKU content quality
rules.notes: Other wordings on noon pages: 'within 2-3 business days', 'up to 2 business days', 'go live within 3 business days'.

rules.requirement: A listed product goes live only when content is QC-approved, price and stock are set, a barcode is mapped to each SKU, the seller is whitelisted for gated brands or categories and (for Fulfilled by Partner) the warehouse is approved.
rules.source_title: Product listing policy

rules.requirement: SKU creation and updates are allowed only through Seller Lab, the NIS bulk upload, noon's public APIs or integrations supported by noon; other channels violate the listing policy.
rules.source_title: Product listing policy

rules.requirement: Beauty categories are gated. UAE (Fragrance, Hair personal care, Colour cosmetics, Electronic personal care): trade licence, VAT certificate, brand authorization letter and invoice from an authorized distributor. KSA Hair personal care: the same plus an SFDA certification document. KSA Fragrance: the same plus a product registration document (Ministry of Commerce). KSA Colour cosmetics and Electronic personal care: the four basic documents.
rules.source_title: Product listing policy
rules.notes: noon's table does not list skin care or oral care separately and does not mention ESMA, ECAS, MoIAT or Montaji for cosmetics (Montaji/MOHAP/DHA certificates are listed only for Health & Nutrition consumables in the UAE). Additional documents may be requested.

rules.requirement: Listing content and images must not contain words from noon's Prohibited Keywords List, pharmaceutical names and ingredients banned by the UAE Ministry of Health and Prevention (MOHAP), or country-specific restricted keywords; detected keywords cause rejection ('Banned Products - This type of products should not be listed').
rules.source_title: Guidelines for prohibited items and keywords
rules.notes: The three keyword lists are Google Sheets linked from the article and were not retrieved, so individual beauty or medical terms cannot be enumerated.

rules.requirement: Saudi Arabia: the keywords 'Christmas', 'Merry Christmas', 'Halloween' and 'Easter' are restricted in titles, descriptions, tags and imagery, and rainbow-coloured products and non-Islamic religious symbols are prohibited.
rules.source_title: Prohibited products

rules.requirement: No sales or promotional wording, prices, shipping or warranty information in titles, bullets, descriptions or images, and no references to other marketplaces.
rules.source_title: Feature bullets (product highlights) and description for the seller SKU

rules.requirement: Product videos must avoid unverified medical or health claims (examples: 'cures headaches', 'heals skin conditions'), must not promote weight loss without the diet-and-exercise qualifier and must not present the product as a substitute for medical advice or treatment.
rules.source_title: Video guidelines and rejection reasons for seller SKUs
rules.notes: This is the only explicit medical-claims rule found; it is written for videos. For text content noon relies on its prohibited keyword lists (not retrieved).

rules.requirement: In videos, environmental claims such as 'eco-friendly' or 'biodegradable' must be backed by credible evidence, and endorsements and testimonials must be truthful and comply with local advertising regulations.
rules.source_title: Video guidelines and rejection reasons for seller SKUs

rules.requirement: Expired products are banned, and product images must not show manufacturing or expiry dates.
rules.source_title: Guidelines for prohibited items and keywords
rules.notes: 'Expired products' are named as an example of banned health-and-safety items in this article; the rule that images must not contain the manufacturing or expiry date is in the image requirements article.

rules.requirement: No explicit noon rule on before/after images, 'anti-bacterial' wording or drug claims in the text of beauty listings was found on the public pages retrieved.
rules.source_title: Guidelines for prohibited items and keywords

enhanced_content.official_name: A+ content (image banners; older help text also calls the banner set a 'Rich Card')
enhanced_content.eligibility: Not publicly documented. The help article describes it as a Seller Lab feature under Catalog > My Catalog > product > Content > Additional Media; no brand-ownership prerequisite is stated.
enhanced_content.modules_note: Image banners only: up to 10 per product, separately for English and Arabic, recommended width 2400 px (minimum 1800, maximum 3600), dynamic height, JPEG/PNG/WebP/AVIF, up to 10 MB each, validated on upload and then reviewed (Pending QC, Approved, Rejected). No text modules, comparison charts or brand-story module are documented. An older banner specification (2000 x 1000 px, 6-13 banners, .jpg) still appears in another help article.

official_quality_signals.official_name: Content status and Completeness (Seller Lab content check)
official_quality_signals.what_it_measures: Where a Seller SKU is in noon's content review and how much of its content has been provided.
official_quality_signals.components: Content status per language (English, Arabic): Content Pending, QC Pending, Approved, Rejected. Completeness percentages: all attributes, mandatory attributes (must be 100% to enter QC), optional attributes. Image status (uploaded or not), Brand status (approved or not). Rejection reasons formatted as 'Attribute - issue' (Categorization, Brand, Title, Image, Feature Bullets/Description), split into fatal content rejections and suggestions for improvement.
official_quality_signals.who_can_access: Sellers in Seller Lab (Content tab of each Seller SKU).
official_quality_signals.notes: This is a status and completeness diagnostic, not a numeric quality score.

official_quality_signals.what_it_measures: The same diagnostics programmatically: content completeness, missing and invalid attributes, QC status and rejection reasons, and per-image review results.
official_quality_signals.components: Per language (LANGUAGE_EN, LANGUAGE_AR): content.completeness, missing_attributes, invalid_attributes; qc.status (QC_STATUS_NOT_ELIGIBLE, QC_STATUS_PENDING, QC_STATUS_APPROVED, QC_STATUS_REJECTED), qc.rejection_reasons, qc.comment; overall_status (ACTIVE, INACTIVE). Per image: review_status (PENDING, VALID, INVALID), visibility and issues (code, message).
official_quality_signals.who_can_access: Sellers and integrators with noon API credentials (POST https://noon-api-gateway.noon.partners/content/v1/product/content/get).
official_quality_signals.notes: Completeness is defined as the percentage of the category's mandatory attributes that are present and valid. ListCategoryAttributes returns required and optional attributes with validation rules per category.

official_quality_signals.what_it_measures: No official numeric listing-quality score for noon was found.
official_quality_signals.notes: One help article mentions filling optional attributes 'to enhance the quality score of your listings' without defining a score; the only documented measures are completeness percentages and QC status.

official_quality_signals.official_name: Seller Rating and Seller Controllable Returns classification
official_quality_signals.what_it_measures: Seller and product quality indicators used for governance, not listing-content quality.
official_quality_signals.components: Seller Rating (minimum 3.0 expected); Seller Controllable Returns classification per offer or brand (Fair, Poor, Very Poor).
official_quality_signals.who_can_access: Sellers in Seller Lab (Account Health & Performance: Reputation Management and Returns Reduction dashboards).
official_quality_signals.notes: Included for completeness; they should not be mapped to a listing-content score. Vantage analytics adds a 'Search Query Score' for keywords, also unrelated to content quality.

non_official_terms_to_avoid.term: noon listing quality score / content score
non_official_terms_to_avoid.what_it_actually_is: Not a documented noon metric. noon exposes content completeness percentages, a per-language QC status and rejection reasons (Seller Lab and the Content API).
Older help-centre wording for the set of detail-page banners; the current feature is called 'A+ content' and has different limits.

limitations: Rules come from noon's public Seller Help Center (helpcenter.noon.partners, discovered through its sitemap) and the public noon API documentation, read on 2026-11-26. The help articles carry no visible last-updated date (the sitemap shows a daily-refreshed lastmod), so source dates are 'n.d.'. Several articles contradict each other or themselves (title length 200 versus 160 and 5 versus 20; video limits; banner specifications; template colour for mandatory fields); both values are recorded. Not retrieved: the Google Sheets with prohibited keywords, MOHAP-banned terms and country-specific restrictions; category templates and the ListCategoryAttributes output, so beauty-specific mandatory attributes are unknown; any documentation for noon's retail/first-party or noon-controlled-brand (NSKU) content standards; eligibility criteria for A+ content. Rules are written for Seller SKUs (seller-owned content). The help-centre category pages could not be rendered by the headless browser (HTTP 502), so article pages were fetched directly.
